requirement_summary.text_fragment: Zstandard frame starts with 4-byte magic number 0xFD2FB528 in little-endian format
Skippable frames start with 4-byte magic number in range 0x184D2A50 to 0x184D2A5F (16 valid values)
Zstandard compressed data is made of one or more frames; each frame is independent and can be decompressed independently
Two frame formats: Zstandard frames (compressed data) and skippable frames (custom user metadata)
Frame header is variable size: minimum 2 bytes, maximum 14 bytes, consisting of Frame_Header_Descriptor, optional Window_Descriptor, optional Dictiona
Frame_Header_Descriptor is 1 byte with 6 bit fields: Frame_Content_Size_Flag (bits 7-6), Single_Segment_Flag (bit 5), unused (bit 4), reserved (bit 3)
Each frame must have at least 1 block; there is no upper limit on the number of blocks per frame
Block_Header is 3 bytes, little-endian, with Last_Block (bit 0), Block_Type (bits 1-2), Block_Size (bits 3-23)
Four block types: Raw_Block (0, uncompressed), RLE_Block (1, single byte repeated), Compressed_Block (2), Reserved (3, invalid)
Block_Maximum_Size is the smallest of Window_Size and 128 KB; constant for a given frame
Content_Checksum is optional 32-bit value using XXH64 hash with seed zero, low 4 bytes stored little-endian
Compressed block consists of Literals_Section and Sequences_Section, combined via Sequence Execution
Two entropy encoding methods: Huffman coding for literals, FSE (Finite State Entropy) for all other symbols
Dictionary magic number is 0xEC30A437; dictionaries must be at least 8 bytes; Dictionary_ID cannot be 0
IANA media type is application/zstd; file extension is .zst; encoding is binary
